brief.concept: How to Analyze a Player Prop With Propeller: Start-to-Finish Walkthrough
brief.primary_question: How do I use a free AI player prop analyzer without mistaking a score for a guaranteed outcome?
brief.audience: New and prospective Propeller users researching a listed player prop on desktop or mobile.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers can confirm the current line, interpret direction and confidence, inspect supporting and conflicting agents, recheck freshness, and decide whether to continue research or pass.
brief.cta: Explore the current Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Capture desktop and mobile interface close to render time. Use the same current prop or clearly label an illustrative/historical example. Show the exact line, direction, confidence, agent breakdown, and freshness/context check.

review.evidence: User explicitly approved the review package and instructed the private upload to proceed.
